value.rationale: The indexed quiver-Grassmannian collection is a natural geometric representation invariant. The theorem fully identifies its information content on an infinite, well-defined family, obtains an exact finite-field coarse-profile/Tutte equivalence, and supplies an infinite cross-ratio family of indecomposable bricks that are provably invisible to it. This gives a concrete boundary for moduli reconstruction despite rigidly fixed labelled arrow data, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
